name: kontiguity-hitchhiker-simple-mlp
description: Mean of 5 ReLU MLPs (12 -> 32 -> 1) on the 12 simple contact-profile features (5-kb bins). Positives: 2-micron (S. cerevisiae), L. fermentati 2-micron-like plasmid, Ddp5 (D. discoideum); negatives: pRS416, pARS, mitochondria, rDNA, unplaced scaffolds, simulated chromosomal fragments and null draws.
